title: Georgia solidarity picket outside Georgian Embassy
notes: LSM reports 30–40 people supporting Georgians; no demand against Latvia’s own state.

title: Georgia solidarity protest at the Freedom Monument
reason: Demands were directed to Georgian authorities; not a Latvian-state target.
notes: LSM reports more than 100 participants, but the documented demands were to stop violence, release detainees and hold elections in Georgia.

title: Georgia solidarity picket outside Congress House
notes: LSM reports a couple dozen; rally voiced support for Georgia and its democratic future.

title: Picket against waste incineration at Saeima
notes: NRA/LETA reports around 20 participants. 6,000 signatures are petition signatories, not event attendees; body capture is duplicated from November and not claimed as a second body read.
